public.text: Countries are encouraged to adapt the model by adjusting, extending, or setting aside elements. However, no practical adaptation workflow is provided. This limits usability for country architecture teams.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a stepwise adaptation method: establish national goals and baseline; select reference elements; map existing systems; identify gaps and overlaps; document adaptations; validate dependencies; assign governance; define transition states; and publish the national model.
